n04e6c57f91.headline: Czech Republic is a paradise for transit trucks. It is among the cheapest countries in Europe
n04e6c57f91.summary: The Czech Republic ranks among the cheapest European countries for freight carriers, with low tolls and fuel costs for heavy trucks.
n04e6c57f91.why: Lower transportation costs enhance the Czech Republic's competitiveness as a logistics hub in Europe, impacting trade and supply chains.
